GenerateMoveStateMachine (protected; not.note: SlitheringStrangler.cs:39-55 - CONSTRICT's FollowUpState is the live RandomBranchState "rand"; THWACK and LASH both FollowUp straight back to CONSTRICT, so the branch is entered on exactly one leg of the cycle. Both branches are AddBranch(state, MoveRepeatType.CanRepeatForever) (:48-49) - overload #10, NO integer argument, weight defaulting to 1f, and CanRepeatForever means GetStateWeight skips the repeat arm entirely (RandomBranchState.cs:142), so it is an unconditional 50/50 every time. SlitheringStranglerNormal's monster composition is picked off the PER-ENCOUNTER selection Rng in the game (SlitheringStranglerNormal.cs:57 `base.Rng.NextItem(Enum.GetValues<SecondaryEnemyType>())`, then :77 `base.Rng.NextItem(_mediumSlimes)` or two small-slime draws - 2 to 3 draws) but the sim's SlitheringStranglerEncounter.create_monsters (slithering_strangler.py:66-77) ignores its `selection_rng` parameter entirely and uses `rng.choice` on the combat rng
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-28: SlitheringStranglerEncounter.create_monsters (slithering_strangler.py:64-87) now routes EVERY composition pick through `selection_rng.next_item`, reproducing SlitheringStranglerNormal.cs:57 (NextItem over Enum.GetValues<SecondaryEnemyType>(), declared SnappingJaxfruit / MediumSlime / SmallSlimes at :12-17 -- the sim's list order ['jaxfruit','medium_slime','small_slimes'] matches), :77 (NextItem over _mediumSlimes = [LeafSlimeM, TwigSlimeM]) and :81-87 (TWO independent NextItem draws over _smallSlimes, i.e. with replacement, which the sim also does). run.py:1299-1309 supplies the stream via rng.make_encounter_rng, seeded as EncounterModel.cs:258-263. WAS: the parameter was ignored and every pick was `rng.choice` on the shared combat rng, leaving the selection stream unconsumed where the game draws 1-3. Legacy runs keep the shared-rng fallback, which is legacy mode's shape.
